source.rationale: A canonical key must preserve platform, bot, and chat identity in their declared positions.
A reset that reports success must move the durable generation fence forward.
Only work that reached adapter dispatch may settle as delivered-unconfirmed.
Migrated reply metadata must become one leading quote rather than trailing metadata.
